subject: Tight-close accelerator MAP: evaluation & MSA/DPA sequencing for Odin Health
messages:
From: hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
To: samira.patel@odinhealth.com, procurement@odinhealth.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-05-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tight-close accelerator MAP & evaluation sequencing (ODN-2026-042)

Hi Samira / Odin procurement team —

Thanks for the productive kickoff earlier this week. Per our conversation, attached is a sharp MAP focused on a ~6-week accelerated close and pilot runway. Key intent: make legal/procurement gating explicit so your internal teams can sign off on sequencing (MSA -> DPA -> Order Form -> provisioning).

In short:
- Week 0 (this week): review MSA redlines and confirm high-risk clauses (data residency, indemnity cap, IP carveouts).
- Week 1: DPA review concurrently (we can accept a DPA redline pass and then align with your privacy counsel).
- Week 2: Order form draft + pricing confirmation; once order form is agreed we trigger provisioning staging.
- Week 3–4: Pilot activation (30-day eval) with canary capacity; metrics and cost telemetry shared via Redwood Console.

What I’m asking from you this week: an MSA redline pass (or a list of top 5 priority changes), and the name of the procurement owner who’ll handle PO/contract signature. I’ve attached the MAP spreadsheet (Odin_MAP_v3.xlsx) with named owners and a column for legal priority.

Attachments: Odin_MAP_v3.xlsx, MSA_redlines_odin_20260526.pdf (our starting redline), SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf (security evidence).

Next steps I propose: quick 30-min sync tomorrow to lock owners and dates. Two candidate times: 10:00–10:30am PT or 3:00–3:30pm PT. Which works best?

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: MSA_redlines_odin_20260526.pdf (PDF)]

Date: 2026-05-27T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tight-close accelerator MAP & evaluation sequencing (ODN-2026-042)

Hannah — thanks for this and for the clear MAP.

High level from procurement/legal side: we can aim for an accelerated cadence but need to validate two things before committing to Week 2 order form: (1) our security team has the SOC2 evidence and a short Q/A (we'll raise any blockers within 3 business days), and (2) we need to confirm commercial terms around termination and liability are within our gate thresholds.

Action items on our end this week:
- I will circulate your MSA redline to our outside counsel and return a summary of material asks by EOD Friday (2026-05-28).
- Tom (cc) will pull together the billing/PO path and confirm whether Odin requires a vendor risk assessment form for Redwood (we use a vendor risk portal).

Quick questions:
1) Does Redwood accept a two-pass redline approach (high-priority clutch items first, then minor language after signature)?
2) If our legal marks require changes to the DPA, can we run those in parallel rather than serial?

We can do the 3:00pm PT slot tomorrow for the sync.

— Samira
Director, Strategic Sourcing | Odin Health
samira.patel@odinhealth.com

- Jonas: confirm we can provision staging after order form countersignature (we'd like to have the provisioning playbook ready to go to avoid a staging delay).

I will join the 3pm sync and outline the MAP owners sheet.

Hannah

Samira / Tom — thanks for the clarity and for the proposed schedule during today’s sync. Quick summary from legal and next steps so procurement has an explicit sequencing plan: 

Agreed sequencing (compact):
1) Focused MSA pass (this week): Redwood legal will prioritize the 6 clutch clauses Hannah flagged and provide a narrow redline reply by close of business Thursday 5/28. That will be our "must-fix" set and we are comfortable moving forward with two-pass handling for non-critical language.
2) DPA in parallel (this week): Karthik will review DPA points; privacy exceptions will be listed separately. If any DPA item is a material privacy risk, we'll flag it as a blocker; otherwise DPA language can be finalized post-signature with an agreed remediation plan.
3) Order Form & Commercial (Week 2): Once MSA/DPA clutch items are acknowledged, we will finalize the order form (pricing and billing path). Order form signature will trigger provisioning staging.
4) DocuSign & Provisioning: We'll push the MSA order form to DocuSign (prepped link below). Provisioning runbooks will be ready so staging can start within 24 hours of countersignature.

Action owners & deadlines:
- Redwood legal (Laura): MSA narrow redline by 2026-05-28 EOB.
- Redwood privacy (Karthik): DPA comments by 2026-05-28 EOB; flag blockers immediately.
- Odin procurement (Samira): material asks list by 2026-05-28 EOB; confirm vendor portal requirements.
- Heather from engineering (cc’d to provisioning playbook in the MAP sheet) — provisioning readiness confirmed by 2026-06-03.

DocuSign draft (preliminary): https://app.docusign.com/agreements/0a1b2c3d-odin-msa

Attachments included in our reply: MSA_redlines_odin_20260526.pdf (our initial positions), SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf.

If Odin agrees to this compact sequencing, we can keep the tight-close MAP intact and hit pilot activation in mid-June. Please confirm and we’ll circulate the DocuSign prefill once Odin confirms the billing path.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
